name: PlantOps IAM
description: Identity, access and the registry every other PlantOps application is described in.

permissions.name: Register application
permissions.description: Add an application to the registry.

permissions.name: View applications
permissions.description: List registered applications.

permissions.name: Edit application
permissions.description: Rename an application or activate and deactivate it.

permissions.name: Upload manifest
permissions.description: Upsert an application's permission and navigation catalog from its manifest.

permissions.name: Add permissions
permissions.description: Add atomic permissions to an application's catalog.

permissions.name: View permissions
permissions.description: List an application's permissions.

permissions.name: Add navigation nodes
permissions.description: Add modules, menus and sub-menus to an application's navigation catalog.

permissions.name: View navigation
permissions.description: List an application's navigation tree.

permissions.name: Map menu permissions
permissions.description: Decide which permissions make a navigation node visible.

permissions.name: Create client
permissions.description: Provision a new tenant.

permissions.name: View clients
permissions.description: List tenants.

permissions.name: Edit client
permissions.description: Rename a tenant, or suspend and reactivate it.

permissions.name: Enable applications
permissions.description: Give a tenant access to an application.

permissions.name: View enabled applications
permissions.description: List the applications enabled for a tenant.

permissions.name: Toggle enabled application
permissions.description: Turn one of a tenant's applications on or off.

permissions.name: Create client admin
permissions.description: Create a tenant's initial administrator.

permissions.name: Read all audit
permissions.description: Read the audit trail across every tenant.

permissions.name: Add scope node
permissions.description: Add a node to the organisation tree.

permissions.name: View scope tree
permissions.description: View the tenant's organisation tree.

permissions.name: Rename or move scope node
permissions.description: Rename a node, or move it and its subtree.

permissions.name: Delete scope node
permissions.description: Remove a node that has nothing anchored to it.

permissions.name: Create role
permissions.description: Create a role.

permissions.name: View roles
permissions.description: List the tenant's roles.

permissions.name: Rename role
permissions.description: Rename a role.

permissions.name: Delete role
permissions.description: Delete a role and the grants that depend on it.

permissions.name: View role permissions
permissions.description: List a role's permissions.

permissions.name: Set role permissions
permissions.description: Change what a role grants, everywhere it is bound.

permissions.name: Create user
permissions.description: Add a person to the tenant.

permissions.name: View users
permissions.description: List and search users, and see their grants.

permissions.name: Edit user
permissions.description: Edit a profile, or lock, unlock and disable an account.

permissions.name: Bulk upload users
permissions.description: Create many users at once from a CSV or JSON roster.

permissions.name: Assign access
permissions.description: Bind a subject to a role at a scope node.

permissions.name: View access
permissions.description: List who holds which role, and where.

permissions.name: Revoke access
permissions.description: Remove a grant.

permissions.name: Create service account
permissions.description: Create a machine identity.

permissions.name: View service accounts
permissions.description: List machine identities.

permissions.name: Rotate service account secret
permissions.description: Issue a new secret and invalidate the old one.

permissions.name: Revoke service account
permissions.description: Revoke or reactivate a machine identity.

permissions.name: Read audit
permissions.description: Read the tenant's own audit trail.
